en.page.title: Account-free request brief
en.page.heading: Ask for missing evidence without hidden lead routing
en.page.summary: Use this static page to prepare a local brief for a RealtyProof evidence request or independent analysis. It does not submit, sell, or route your details.
en.overview.heading: Read this before writing the brief
en.overview.deliverable.title: Deliverable
en.overview.deliverable.body: A local downloadable brief listing the project or registration number, evidence gaps and buyer questions to review later.
en.overview.limitations.title: Exclusions and limitations
en.overview.limitations.body: No legal, investment, tax or title opinion is produced here. Missing evidence remains unavailable, not neutral or positive.
en.overview.routing.title: Routing
en.overview.routing.body: Your request is not shared with a builder, broker or lender. This standalone page keeps the brief in your browser until you download it.
en.overview.sla.title: SLA and pricing
en.overview.sla.body: Unavailable until approved. There is no payment collection on this page.
en.overview.privacy.title: Privacy and retention
en.overview.privacy.body: Backend consent, deletion and retention gates are not approved, so this page does not collect contact or personal data.
en.overview.influence.title: No payment or rating influence
en.overview.influence.body: Payment cannot influence public evidence, correction priority, score, rating, rank or coverage.
en.overview.official.title: Official text stays official
en.overview.official.body: Official project names, promoter names, IDs, RERA numbers, source titles and quoted source text stay exactly as published.
en.request.type.evidence.title: Evidence request
en.request.type.evidence.body: Use when a public project record is missing a source, status or document link.
en.request.type.analysis.title: Independent analysis
en.request.type.analysis.body: Use when you need a question-led dossier scope after known gaps are visible.
en.request.form.heading: Build a local brief
en.request.form.notice: Do not enter names, phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses or payment details. The brief should contain project or RERA, evidence gaps and questions only.
en.request.project.label: Project or RERA registration
en.request.project.help: Example: official project name, phase, sector or RERA registration number. Preserve the official spelling.
en.request.gaps.label: Evidence gaps
en.request.gaps.help: List missing RERA/QPR, OC/CC, map, price-source, litigation, lender, authority-dues or possession evidence.
en.request.questions.label: Questions to answer
en.request.questions.help: Ask evidence questions only. Avoid personal facts or contact details.
en.request.preview.heading: Brief preview
en.request.preview.empty: Nothing to download yet. Add a project/RERA, evidence gap or question.
en.request.download.ready: Local brief is ready. Review the downloaded file before sharing it anywhere.
en.request.submit.blocker: Submission is blocked until backend consent, legal, retention and deletion gates are approved.
en.request.error.empty: Add at least one project/RERA, evidence gap or question before downloading.
en.request.error.personal: Remove contact or personal-data terms before downloading. This page is intentionally account-free.
en.risks.identity: Unresolved promoter, SPV or phase identity
en.risks.parcel: Title, lease, encumbrance or parcel mismatch
en.risks.authority: Authority cancellation, serious dues or enforcement
en.risks.ibc: Completion-threatening IBC, court or lender event
en.risks.assuredReturns: Assured returns or misleading possession claim
en.risks.staleCritical: Stale critical evidence or authoritative conflict
en.calculator.assumptions: Every assumption must be editable and labelled as source evidence, user assumption, product default or unavailable.
en.calculator.scenarios: Show conservative, base and upside scenarios as ranges, never as a buy or sell recommendation.
en.calculator.missing: Missing values stay unavailable and must not be treated as zero.
en.calculator.irr: Internal Rate of Return (IRR) is only a calculation output; it is not a recommendation.
en.legal.warning: Legal claims are outside this glossary. Official legal text must be read in the original source language.

hi.page.title: बिना खाते का अनुरोध ब्रीफ
hi.page.heading: छिपी हुई लीड-रूटिंग के बिना कमी वाले सबूत पूछें
hi.page.summary: इस स्थिर पेज से RealtyProof evidence request या independent analysis के लिए स्थानीय ब्रीफ तैयार करें। यह आपकी जानकारी submit, sell या route नहीं करता।
hi.overview.heading: ब्रीफ लिखने से पहले यह पढ़ें
hi.overview.deliverable.title: डिलिवरेबल
hi.overview.deliverable.body: बाद में review के लिए project या registration number, evidence gaps और buyer questions वाली local downloadable brief।
hi.overview.limitations.title: सीमाएँ और exclusions
hi.overview.limitations.body: यहाँ कोई legal, investment, tax या title opinion नहीं बनता। Missing evidence unavailable ही रहता है, neutral या positive नहीं।
hi.overview.routing.title: रूटिंग
hi.overview.routing.body: आपका request builder, broker या lender के साथ shared नहीं होता। यह standalone page brief को download होने तक आपके browser में रखता है।
hi.overview.sla.title: SLA और pricing
hi.overview.sla.body: Approved होने तक unavailable। इस page पर कोई payment collection नहीं है।
hi.overview.privacy.title: Privacy और retention
hi.overview.privacy.body: Backend consent, deletion और retention gates approved नहीं हैं, इसलिए यह page contact या personal data collect नहीं करता।
hi.overview.influence.title: Payment या rating influence नहीं
hi.overview.influence.body: Payment public evidence, correction priority, score, rating, rank या coverage को influence नहीं कर सकता।
hi.overview.official.title: Official text official ही रहता है
hi.overview.official.body: Official project names, promoter names, IDs, RERA numbers, source titles और quoted source text exactly as published रहते हैं।
hi.request.type.evidence.title: Evidence request
hi.request.type.evidence.body: जब public project record में source, status या document link missing हो, तब use करें।
hi.request.type.analysis.title: Independent analysis
hi.request.type.analysis.body: जब known gaps दिखने के बाद question-led dossier scope चाहिए, तब use करें।
hi.request.form.heading: Local brief बनाएं
hi.request.form.notice: Names, phone numbers, email addresses, home addresses या payment details enter न करें। Brief में केवल project या RERA, evidence gaps और questions होने चाहिए।
hi.request.project.label: Project या RERA registration
hi.request.project.help: Example: official project name, phase, sector या RERA registration number। Official spelling preserve करें।
hi.request.gaps.label: Evidence gaps
hi.request.gaps.help: Missing RERA/QPR, OC/CC, map, price-source, litigation, lender, authority-dues या possession evidence list करें।
hi.request.questions.label: जवाब देने वाले questions
hi.request.questions.help: केवल evidence questions पूछें। Personal facts या contact details avoid करें।
hi.request.preview.heading: Brief preview
hi.request.preview.empty: Download के लिए अभी कुछ नहीं है। Project/RERA, evidence gap या question add करें।
hi.request.download.ready: Local brief ready है। कहीं share करने से पहले downloaded file review करें।
hi.request.submit.blocker: Backend consent, legal, retention और deletion gates approved होने तक submission blocked है।
hi.request.error.empty: Download से पहले कम से कम एक project/RERA, evidence gap या question add करें।
hi.request.error.personal: Download से पहले contact या personal-data terms हटाएँ। यह page intentionally account-free है।
hi.risks.identity: Promoter, SPV या phase identity unresolved
hi.risks.parcel: Title, lease, encumbrance या parcel mismatch
hi.risks.authority: Authority cancellation, serious dues या enforcement
hi.risks.ibc: Completion-threatening IBC, court या lender event
hi.risks.assuredReturns: Assured returns या misleading possession claim
hi.risks.staleCritical: Stale critical evidence या authoritative conflict
hi.calculator.assumptions: हर assumption editable हो और source evidence, user assumption, product default या unavailable के रूप में labelled हो।
hi.calculator.scenarios: Conservative, base और upside scenarios ranges के रूप में दिखाएँ, buy या sell recommendation के रूप में नहीं।
hi.calculator.missing: Missing values unavailable ही रहते हैं और zero की तरह treat नहीं किए जाने चाहिए।
hi.calculator.irr: Internal Rate of Return (IRR / आंतरिक प्रतिफल दर) केवल calculation output है; recommendation नहीं।
